The caller never gets to invoke 'replace' (which returned "one" on the old version) or 'size' (which returned 2). Because the shade plugin relocates org.objectweb.asm into the released jar, a release built with this POM would ship the failing behavior to downstream consumers whatever ASM version they have on their own classpath.
